hints.title: Core Idea
hints.text: We want candidates who possess all three required skills: Python, Tableau, and PostgreSQL.

hints.title: Key Observation
hints.text: Filter the Candidates table for skills in ('Python', 'Tableau', 'PostgreSQL').

hints.title: Query Construction
hints.text: Group by candidate_id and use having count(distinct skill) = 3 to keep only candidates possessing all three skills.

hints.title: Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT candidate_id
FROM Candidates
WHERE skill IN ('Python', 'Tableau', 'PostgreSQL')
GROUP BY candidate_id
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT skill) = 3
ORDER BY candidate_id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Filtering skill set followed by candidate grouping and distinct count check.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Separate subqueries per skill incur multiple unnecessary scans.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(N) memory for grouping hash table.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use group by with having count condition to verify multiple required skills.
